reviews.text: Kensington Home Services did an amazing job on our bathroom renovation. We had to do a full demo and rebuild, and we are so pleased with the results. Bruce, Dean, and Joe were all extremely professional, knowledgeable, and pleasant to work with. We truly appreciated their attention to detail and craftsmanship.

We hired Kensington to remodel our bathroom. It was a big job. Our existing bathroom was a mess and needed to be entirely ripped out and replaced. Bruce was extremely professional. He was prompt, courteous, and fair. Joe did a wonderful job. He was hard-working, prompt, professional and skilled. The bathroom turned out great. They kept to their estimate. The work was done on time. They were easy to work with and, overall, we can’t say enough good things.

Joe was fast, efficient and friendly. He helped us build shelving for our nursery, and spackled our plaster walls where they were uneven. We are very pleased overall with our experience with Kensington Home, and would definitely use them again!
